scope: Real released Router0.1.16 binaries on x86 and ARM, four mock physical DP ranks, all original 66 core requests plus seven fresh-router retention requests per architecture. CPU-only functionality; no model numerical or throughput claim.
observed_behavior: At fixed KV pressure 0.35 on the original owner and 0.2 on the other ranks, a 33000-character prefix stays on rank 0 immediately but moves to rank 1 after 32 seconds. A 2300-character prefix and the existing long-prefix session retain rank 0.

affinity_retention.scope: Fresh released binary, mock backend; fixed pressure spans a full eviction interval.
Fresh released binary, mock backend; fixed pressure spans a full eviction interval.

native_source_evidence.capacity_unit: Characters in routing metadata, separate from GPU KV token capacity.
native_source_evidence.program_binding_configuration_limit: CacheAwareBinding creates its own default CacheAwarePolicy; the existing top-level cache policy size does not configure this binding instance.

earlier_cpu_drafts: Discarded: an initial raw-body comparison ignored native serialization defaults; the input candidate mode leaked into its hash control; pressure fallback had already taught another owner; and a fresh runtime needs its first model request before observation targets register. The accepted published-source 50163 runs correct these conditions. One uncommitted-source preview supplies no accepted evidence.
